title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Lazi National Agricultural School in Barangay Tigbawan, Municipality of Lazi, Province of Siquijor Into Lazi Technical Institute

text.en: Renaming of a National Agricultural School. – The name of Lazi National Agricultural School in Barangay Tigbawan, Municipality of Lazi, Province of Siquijor is hereby changed to Lazi Technical Institute.
Location of the Main Campus. – The main campus of the Lazi Technical Institute shall continue to remain in its present location in Barangay Tigbawan, Municipality of Lazi, Province of Siquijor.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
